name: Deuces Wylde

date.source: The broadcast's own graphic, self-dated to the MGM Grand Hotel, Las Vegas, Nevada.

matches.note: The challenger reversed a Gorilla Press attempt into a tiger suplex for the pin, avenging a loss to the same champion two months earlier.
A brutal outside brawl: the champions' own manager distracted a challenger with a chair shot before the champions powerbombed him onto bare concrete and won by countout at the ten count.

matches.stipulation: NOW World Heavyweight Championship, No Escape match; main event
matches.note: Ended the champion's own undefeated (8-0) reign and win streak; the referee stopped the match after a top-rope Flying Tomahawk leg drop left both men unconscious.

no_appearances_reason: A three-day-caliber twelve-match card: two SJPW interfederation title defenses and one SOW interfederation title-shot match (crediting existing rosters at other Usenet federations outside this record's own scope) and five further NOW matches (a grudge match, a tag match, two special singles attractions, and a Junior Heavyweight Championship ladder match whose own finish is not preserved in the surviving text) are served in full below but not individually structured this reading.

evidence.source: The promotion's own three-day-caliber pay-per-view, reposted for nostalgia in 1999 and now served in full from the original broadcast script.
evidence.note: Three championship changes across a twelve-match card headlined by the end of an undefeated title reign.

notes: A season-opening interfederation pay-per-view crediting guest talent from SJPW and SOW; the promotion's own nine matches carry three championship changes.
